title: Spectral Echo
description: The translucent image of a long-dead warrior flickers in and out of existence at a crossroads of crumbling stone corridors. Its mouth moves soundlessly, one gauntleted hand gesturing down a passage choked with shadow. Whether it means to warn or to lure, the spirit seems bound to this place, repeating its final moments for eternity.

choices.label: Follow the echo
choices.description: The dead sometimes guard forgotten treasure.

choices.label: Capture the spectral thread
choices.description: A quick hand can snare the ectoplasmic strands that trail behind it.

choices.label: Listen to its whispers
choices.description: The echo's murmuring carries a strange, restorative calm.

choices.label: Ignore the apparition
choices.description: Spectral echoes are unreliable guides at best.
